close_reason: deferred P4 doc: build_path is not required to be called with leaf certs; validate_path enforces chain structure; this is a minor doc enhancement not a correctness issue
description: In pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs, build_path() (line 323) accepts any Certificate as target and does not check whether it is a leaf. A caller passing an intermediate CA cert as target would receive a chain [ca_cert, parent_ca, ...] which, when passed to validate_path, would fail because validate_path assumes chain[0] is the leaf. There is no doc comment clarifying that target must be a leaf cert. This is a missing # Panics / # Errors note at minimum, and ideally a structural guard or explicit documentation.
title: pkix-path-builder build_path does not reject the case where target is a CA cert (no leaf-first ordering guarantee)
